_comment: Example prompts for a coding agent with the Seyd skill installed. Rendered by the landing page and the docs (mountPromptDeck in @seyd/theme). Keep each one a single sentence or two a person would actually type.

prompts.label: Get to know Seyd
prompts.text: I've never used Seyd. Explain what it does and what it refuses to do, then put the public demo robot in a page of my own so I can drive it.

prompts.label: I have a robot
prompts.text: I have a warehouse rover on a Jetson with a camera that publishes RTSP. We drive it over Wi-Fi today; I want to drive it from the office across town. Integrate it with Seyd.

prompts.label: A drone
prompts.text: My drone's video leaves a Python process as H.264 access units. Which form factor fits, and what exactly do I have to implement?

prompts.label: My web app
prompts.text: Add a drivable video feed for robot acme-rover-1 to our React ops console, with controls that stop the rover when the operator's tab goes away.

prompts.label: Won't connect
prompts.text: The pilot shows robot-cgnat from the office. The rover is behind a 4G router. What do I change, and what will the relay cost me meanwhile?

prompts.label: Review my setup
prompts.text: Review my seydd.toml and my GStreamer pipeline against the publisher contract and tell me what breaks under packet loss.

prompts.label: Prove it works
prompts.text: Walk me through verifying the integration end to end, including loss injection and a pilot on another network, and write up the numbers.
